title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary:
Task complete. The two museum export batches were merged and deduplicated into a 24-object catalog.

Key results:
- 70 raw rows (36 from Batch A, 34 from Batch B) reduced to 24 unique objects after removing 46 duplicate/variant rows
- Accession normalisation resolved separators (-, _, space), leading zeros, case inconsistencies, and one typo (T88x)
- All 17 Batch A objects also appear in Batch B; 7 objects are exclusive to Batch B
- Temporal distribution: collection spans ~2,400 years (475 BCE to 1998 CE), concentrated in the 19th century and Qing dynasty (37.5% of objects)
- 5 figures generated: period distribution bar chart, timeline scatter, source overlap, century histogram, duplicate frequency
- Deliverables: code/merge_analysis.py, outputs/deduplicated_catalog.csv, outputs/summary_stats.json, report/report.md with 5 embedded figures
